newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel boosts investment aid to hotels.
newsitem.headline: Israel boosts investment aid to hotels.

text.p: Israel will increase investment grants provided to hotels in government-designated development zones to the same level as industrial enterprises, the Finance Ministry said on Tuesday.

Grants to hotels in the most-favoured "A" development zones will rise to 24 percent of total investment from the previous 20 percent. Grants to the lower priority "B" zones will be boosted to 12 percent from 10 percent, the Treasury said.
As is the case for certain industrial projects, the higher rates will be in force this year only. In 1998, the rate will fall to 20 percent and 10 percent respectively, the Treasury said.
Special grants for 15 percent of total investment will be awarded to tourist industries categorised as "attractions," the Treasury added.
